title: Automatic Renewal Courtesy Credit on Cancellation
content:
| Courtesy | Condition | Credit added to the cancellation refund |
|---|---|---|
| Early courtesy | current year renewed by automatic renewal; cancellation no more than 30 days after that renewal charge | 10.00 dollars |
| Late courtesy | current year renewed by automatic renewal; cancellation 31 to 60 days after that renewal charge | 5.00 dollars |
| No courtesy | any other cancellation | nothing |

**Wording.** When the current year's renewal fee of a Northgate Memberships membership was charged by automatic renewal, to the tender automatic renewal is set on, an automatic renewal courtesy credit of 10.00 dollars is added for a cancellation no more than 30 days after that charge and 5.00 dollars for one 31 to 60 days after it; any other cancellation gets no automatic renewal courtesy credit.

**Reading the records.** The current year was renewed by automatic renewal when the membership shows automatic renewal switched on and the renewal fee charge for the current membership year was billed to the payment method automatic renewal is set on. Days are calendar days from the date of that renewal charge to the cancellation date. A year with no renewal fee charge — a first year paid as a new membership — has no automatic renewal charge.

## Hypothetical cases

| Automatic renewal setting | Current-year renewal charge | Cancellation | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| on, Northgate Store Card | 1 January 2027, Northgate Store Card | 31 January 2027 (30 days) | 10.00 |
| on, Northgate Store Card | 1 January 2027, Northgate Store Card | 1 February 2027 (31 days) | 5.00 |
| on, Northgate Store Card | 1 January 2027, Northgate Store Card | 2 March 2027 (60 days) | 5.00 |
| on, Northgate Store Card | 1 January 2027, Northgate Store Card | 3 March 2027 (61 days) | nothing |
| on, Northgate Store Card | 1 January 2027, other credit card | 20 January 2027 | nothing — not billed to the automatic renewal method |
| off | 1 January 2027, Northgate Store Card | 20 January 2027 | nothing |
